posts.description: Most of a dental implant timeline is healing, not appointments. The implant is placed, then the bone grows against the titanium surface over a period of months, and only after that does the final crown go on. You are not in a dental chair for that stretch, you are living normally. Understanding this changes the whole conversation about whether now is a good time. We Dental in Boca Raton, Florida maps your phases before you commit to anything. Book your appointment.

Bonding and porcelain veneers solve different problems. Bonding is composite resin shaped directly on the tooth in one visit and works well for a single chip or a small gap. Veneers are custom ceramic, made in a lab, and they handle color, shape and alignment across the whole smile at once. Choosing the smaller treatment when it is enough is part of the job.

At We Dental in Boca Raton, Florida, we will tell you when bonding is all you need. Book your appointment.

A dental implant cannot get a cavity, but the gum and bone holding it absolutely can get inflamed. That makes daily cleaning around the implant and regular professional visits the two things that decide how long it lasts. The American Dental Association recommends a checkup roughly every six months for most adults, and implant patients have a clear reason to keep it. Nothing exotic is required. We Dental in Boca Raton, Florida shows you the routine at delivery. Book your appointment.

Modern porcelain veneers remove a very thin layer of enamel, and in selected cases almost none at all. The amount depends on your starting position: crowded teeth need more preparation, worn or slightly small teeth often need very little. Preserving natural tooth structure is a planning goal, not an afterthought. If a plan does not mention how much enamel comes off, ask. We Dental in Boca Raton, Florida puts that number in front of you first. Book your appointment.

People who choose full mouth dental implants rarely talk about teeth afterward. They talk about steak, corn, apples and eating at someone else's house without planning around it. Implant supported teeth transmit chewing force into the jaw bone the way natural roots do, which is why bite strength returns in a way removable dentures cannot match. That is the whole point. We Dental in Boca Raton, Florida plans these cases in phases you can actually live with. Book your appointment.

Porcelain veneers are thin ceramic shells bonded to the front of your teeth to correct shape, color and alignment. Done well, they look like the best version of your own teeth, not a row of identical white blocks. The difference is in the plan: tooth proportion, edge translucency and how the smile line follows your lip. Patients in Boca Raton, Florida often arrive worried about looking fake. That worry is the right instinct, and it is exactly what a proper smile design protects. Book your appointment.

An implant needs bone to hold it. When a tooth has been missing for years, the ridge underneath has usually narrowed, and a bone graft rebuilds that foundation before the implant goes in. It is an extra phase, not a complication, and knowing about it early is what keeps a plan realistic. This is one of the reasons a scan comes before a quote. We Dental in Boca Raton, Florida shows you your own anatomy before proposing anything. Book your appointment.

Almost everyone has a photograph where they smiled with their mouth closed on purpose. That habit is so automatic most people stop noticing it. A cosmetic consultation is not a commitment to treatment, it is a conversation about what is actually possible for your teeth and what it would take. Sometimes the answer is much smaller than expected. We Dental in Boca Raton, Florida is rated 5.0 by 149 patients and there is no pressure to proceed. Book your appointment.

An implant consultation answers four questions: whether you have enough bone, whether a graft is needed first, how many phases your case takes and what the alternatives are. You leave with your own scan and a plan you can think about, or take elsewhere. There is no upselling at We Dental in Boca Raton, Florida, and no treatment starts before you understand it. Would having the actual facts change how you think about that gap? Book your appointment.

We Glow is the facial aesthetics side of We Dental, and it runs on the same standard as our dental work: assessment first, conservative dosing and a documented plan. Treatments include Botox, facial fillers, Sculptra, microneedling and facial peels. Being inside a dental practice in Boca Raton, Florida means your face and your smile are assessed as one thing, because that is how people actually see them. Book your appointment.

A dental implant replaces one tooth without touching the teeth beside it. A bridge replaces the same tooth by reshaping the two healthy neighbors to carry it. That is the real trade off, and it is a decision about the teeth you still have, not only about the one you lost. Some mouths are better served by a bridge, and we say so. Patients across Boca Raton, Florida come to We Dental for a plan that starts with what you keep. Book your appointment.

A porcelain veneer case is designed around your facial proportions, your lip line and the way you actually smile, not around a shade guide. Tooth width, edge shape and the curve of the smile line all follow the face they sit in, which is why the same veneers would be wrong on someone else. This is the difference between cosmetic dentistry and a product. We Dental in Boca Raton, Florida is rated 5.0 by 149 patients, and the planning is why. Book your appointment.

Denture wearers develop a set of quiet habits: chewing on one side, choosing soft food in restaurants and covering the mouth when laughing hard. Implant supported teeth are anchored to the jaw bone, so those habits become unnecessary rather than managed. Many patients describe the change in terms of speech and confidence before they mention food. If any of that sounds familiar, it is worth one conversation. We Dental in Boca Raton, Florida starts with a scan. Book your appointment.
